frame_ms_in_step.note: CPU time inside PlayableTestRuntime.step per frame, printed every 600 frames by main.py; the browser's own compositing comes on top

how_shots_were_taken: pygame.image.save of the display surface inside the page (python.PyRun_SimpleString), read from the Emscripten file system (Module.FS) and POSTed to the serve command's /shot endpoint; keyboard input dispatched as KeyboardEvents with a `code` (the browser tool's own key presses carry none, which SDL needs)
